Item Name: Interface Box

NSN: 7025-01-706-1912

Part Number: 13045871

Minimum Quantity: 203 each

Maximum Quantity: 819 each

End Item: Bradley

Description: This Interface Box is an external training device used on routes RS 170 signals from the long-range advanced scout surveillance system (LRAS3) and multiple integrated laser engagement system (MILES) training equipment to the improved Bradley acquisition subsystem (IBAS) and commanders independent view (CIV). This item is used on the Bradley Fighting Vehicle.

Technical Data is not available for this procurement.  Procurement is source controlled to Benchmark Electronics (CAGE: 380Q6).

Note that this is not a request for proposal.
